title: Trip Protection Underwriting Rules: Active Policies per Stay and the Insured Trip Cost
content:
A stay may carry no more than the plan's maximum number of active Trip Protection policies, and a Trip Protection plan cannot insure a stay whose total price or length goes beyond that plan's limits.

## Rules

1. **Active policies on a stay.** A stay may carry no more active Trip Protection policies than the plan's maximum number of active policies on one stay. The count is taken at the moment the policy is written and includes only the policies on that same stay whose status is active; a policy that has been cancelled in the free look, voided or has expired is not counted.
2. **Changing plans.** A guest who wants a different plan cancels the first policy within its free look and buys the second.
3. **Insured trip cost.** The insured trip cost is the stay's total price, insured in full. It may not exceed the plan's highest insured trip cost; a stay whose total price is above that cost cannot be insured on that plan.
4. **Trip length.** A stay longer than the plan's longest covered stay cannot be insured on that plan.

## Points of judgement

| Fact about the stay | Result under the rules |
|---|---|
| The stay already carries an active policy and the plan's maximum is one | A further policy cannot be written on that stay |
| The stay's only earlier policy shows cancelled in the free look, voided or expired | That policy does not count toward the maximum |
| The stay's total price equals the plan's highest insured trip cost | It does not exceed it; the cost limit does not bar the stay |
| The stay's total price is above the plan's highest insured trip cost | The stay cannot be insured on that plan |
| The stay's length equals the plan's longest covered stay | It is not longer; the length limit does not bar the stay |
| The stay is longer than the plan's longest covered stay | The stay cannot be insured on that plan |

## Hypothetical illustration

A plan's highest insured trip cost is taken, for illustration only, as 20000.00 USD. A stay priced at 20000.00 USD is insured at 20000.00 USD, its full total price. A stay priced at 20000.01 USD cannot be insured on that plan, and insuring only part of its price is not available, because the insured trip cost is always the full total price.
